notes.title: Announcement about Cargo Simulator
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,
We’re truly sorry. Although we submitted the game a week ago, we faced a technical issue during the release process, which caused a delay. We’ve already fixed the problem and resubmitted it for review. As soon as it’s approved, we’ll release the game right away.[/p][p]Thank you for your patience and for believing in us — it means everything to us. ❤️[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Cargo Simulator – Demo Is Now Live!
notes.content: [p][img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f69b.png"][/img] Cargo Simulator – Demo Is Now Live![/p][p]Hello everyone![/p][p] The wait is over: the [b]first playable demo[/b] of [i]Cargo Simulator[/i] is now available on Steam![/p][p] Pack your goods and get ready for delivery.[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f579-fe0f.png"][/img] Demo Content[/p][p]In this first version, you can experience:[/p][p][img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f69a.png"][/img] Cargo packing task[/p][p] [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f4e6.png"][/img] Various cargo types (fragile, express delivery)[/p][p] [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f4b0.png"][/img] Basic economic system[/p][p] [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f3ae.png"][/img] Employee hiring and shop expansion mechanics[/p][p]This demo is designed for you to test the core mechanics and share your feedback with us.[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f527.png"][/img] Development Continues![/p][p]We’re gathering your feedback and expanding the game world. Here’s what’s coming soon:[/p][p][img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f69b.png"][/img] Vehicle-based cargo delivery[/p][p] [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f465.png"][/img] Driver hiring and company management[/p][p] [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f6a6.png"][/img] Advanced traffic and dynamic systems[/p][p] [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f5fa-fe0f.png"][/img] Larger map and new cities[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f4e2.png"][/img] Your Feedback Matters[/p][p]If you encounter any bugs, issues, or have suggestions, we’d love to hear from you![/p][p] Leave a comment in the Steam discussion area or join our Discord server.[/p][p] Remember: we’re building this road together![img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f449.png"][/img] Download the demo now and start your first delivery![/p][p] The road is long, the load is heavy — but together, anything is possible![/p][p]— [i]Cargo Simulator Dev Team[/i][/p]
